metadata.name: Service Release
metadata.description: Roll a tagged build out to the web servers: preflight checks and build verification in parallel, an approval, then deploy, smoke test and announce.

inputs.name: hosts
inputs.label: Target hosts
inputs.description: Nodes or a tag to release to. Leave empty for every node tagged web.

with.script:
set -euo pipefail
free_gb=$(df -BG --output=avail /opt | tail -1 | tr -dc '0-9')
echo "$(hostname): ${free_gb}G free under /opt, current release $(readlink /opt/app/current || echo none)"
if [ "$free_gb" -lt 2 ]; then
  echo "need at least 2G free under /opt" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "FREE_GB=$free_gb" >> "$FC_OUTPUT"
echo "RELEASE_DIR=/opt/app/releases/$VERSION" >> "$FC_OUTPUT_GLOBAL"

set -eu
: "${TOKEN:?ARTIFACT_TOKEN secret is not set}"
apk add --no-cache curl > /dev/null
cd "$FC_ARTIFACTS"
curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o app.tar.gz "$BASE_URL/app-$VERSION.tar.gz"
expected=$(curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$BASE_URL/app-$VERSION.tar.gz.sha256" | cut -d" " -f1)
actual=$(sha256sum app.tar.gz | cut -d" " -f1)
if [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then
  echo "checksum mismatch: expected $expected, got $actual" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "BUILD_SHA256=$actual" >> "$FC_OUTPUT"

set -euo pipefail
echo "$BUILD_SHA256  $FC_ARTIFACTS/local/app.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
mkdir -p "$RELEASE_DIR"
tar -xzf "$FC_ARTIFACTS/local/app.tar.gz" -C "$RELEASE_DIR"
ln -sfn "$RELEASE_DIR" /opt/app/current
systemctl restart app

set -euo pipefail
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz; then
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 3
done
echo "app did not become healthy on $(hostname)" >&2
exit 1
